snippet.title: Rabbit Trail - Official Trailer | Solve Puzzles, Uncover Mysteries, and Find the Carrots! 🐇🥕
snippet.description:
Embark on a charming and mysterious adventure in Rabbit Trail! 🐇✨ This puzzle game invites you to guide clever rabbits through intricate trails filled with challenges, secrets, and surprises. Your goal? Solve mind-bending puzzles to help the rabbits reach their cherished carrots 🥕, while uncovering the hidden mysteries of their whimsical world.

With enchanting visuals, clever mechanics, and a touch of intrigue, Rabbit Trail promises a journey that will test your wits and warm your heart. Wishlist now on Steam and prepare to hop into the fun! 🎮💡
